title: Harness capability document
description: What one harness can do through this core, stated honestly, and what this core's host can take right now. Every capability name is always present. A control action whose capability is not supported is refused with an `unsupported` error naming it, never dropped or simulated. `limits`, `active_runs` and `admission` describe this core's own host and never another one.

available.description: Whether the core can start this harness right now (binary, credentials and sandbox present).

version.description: The harness's own version string as detected, or null if unknown.

transport.description: Neutral one-line description of how the core drives the harness (for example `interactive session over a local bridge`). Informational only.

limits.description: The limits the operator configured on this core. Absent when the core does not report them.

active_runs.description: How many runs are active on this core's host right now, across every harness and repository. Absent when the core does not report it.

admission.description: What each admission signal says for this harness on this host right now. Absent when the core does not report it.

capability_name.description: Every capability the contract can name in a capability document or an `unsupported` error.

reason.description: Why it is unsupported (required then), or null when supported.

caveats.description: Known limits of a supported capability, for example that cancel can leave a harness child process running until the sandbox is deleted.

deferred.description: A capability no harness supports in this API version: pause, resume, continue_session and delegate. Changing one to supportable is a schema change (README: versioning).

limit_name.description: A limit an operator can configure. runs_per_repository: active runs in one repository. runs_per_host: active runs on the core's host.

limits.description: Every limit by name. null means the operator configured none, and then no submit is refused for it. No limit applies unless one is configured.

signal_name.description: An admission signal. heat: the host's heat state. gateway: the model gateway's admit state, for harnesses that use the gateway.

signal_state.description: admit: the signal allows new work. hold: it says not to start new work. unknown: it is missing or stale; it is never read as admit or as a failure of the control plane.

signal.description: One admission signal as this core read it.

consulted.description: Whether admission reads this signal for this harness. When false the state does not affect admission and `reason` says why it is not read.

reason.description: Why the state is hold or unknown, or why the signal is not consulted. null only for a plain admit.

observed_at.description: The time the signal's publisher stamped on the reading, or null when there is no reading.
